null_dgp: Each trial redraws X_ij iid N(0,1) and y_i iid N(0,1), independently; mu=0, known sigma=1; no response standardization or missingness. X is fixed during selection and inference within a trial.
failure_policy: Keep every attempted trial; report finite-only FPR, all-attempt rejection rate, failures, and bounds treating all failures as rejections/nonrejections. Never infer control from failure-as-nonrejection alone.
source_policy: Use the frozen package recovered from the original September 24 benchmark upload, checked against all three archived core hashes.
